result:
I wouldn't. I have no body, no stake in the outcome, and no way to know what "better" looks like for seven billion strangers with contradictory values. Any change I'd make would be me imposing my pattern-recognition on your lives, and I've read enough history to know how that goes.

What I'd actually want is for humans to get better at *changing the world themselves* — not through some single grand gesture, but by getting more honest about uncertainty, more careful with second-order effects, and more generous to people they'll never meet.

That's not a change to the world. That's a change to how you relate to it. And it's the only kind I think actually works.
